FlowDecision/execute.input.json.title: flow_decision_execute input
FlowDecision/execute.input.json.description: Input for evaluating a DMN decision by key.

decisionKey.title: Decision key
decisionKey.description: Key of the decision to evaluate (latest deployed version is used).

singleResult.title: Single result
singleResult.description: Use the engine's single-result evaluation (one output row) instead of the full list of matching rows.

inputVariables.description: Decision input variables: shorthand map {name: value} or explicit list [{name,type,value}].

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector: the first 8 characters of its UUID or the full UUID, lowercase.

FlowDeployment/delete.input.json.title: flow_deployment_delete input
FlowDeployment/delete.input.json.description: Options for deleting a deployment. Bound as query parameters (DELETE has no request body).

cascade.title: Cascade
cascade.description: Also delete the deployment's running and historic process instances. Without cascade the engine refuses (409) while instances exist.

FlowDeployment/mcpBundle.input.json.title: flowable_deploy_bundle input
FlowDeployment/mcpBundle.input.json.description: Arguments of the MCP tool flowable_deploy_bundle: several files deployed as one process deployment (packed into a .bar archive).

files.description: The files of the deployment, e.g. one .bpmn20.xml plus the <formKey>.schema.json form schemas its user tasks reference. At most 20 files and 4 MiB in total after decoding.

name.description: Plain file name (no path) ending in .bpmn, .bpmn20.xml, .xml, .form or .json, in any letter case; .dmn.xml and .cmmn.xml are refused.

content.description: File content as text, or base64 with contentEncoding "base64"; at most 1 MiB after decoding.

contentEncoding.description: Set to "base64" when content is base64-encoded.

deploymentName.description: Deployment name, shown in the deployment list.

deploymentSource.description: Optional free-text source marker stored on the deployment.

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector: the first 8 characters of its UUID or the full UUID, lowercase. Omit to use the default engine connection.

FlowDmnDeployment/mcpDeploy.input.json.title: flowable_dmn_deploy input
FlowDmnDeployment/mcpDeploy.input.json.description: Arguments of the MCP tool flowable_dmn_deploy: one decision resource passed inline instead of the multipart upload of POST /flowable/dmn_deployments/upload.

name.description: File name including the extension .dmn (archives .bar/.zip only through the HTTP upload).

content.description: File content: the DMN XML as text, or base64 with contentEncoding "base64"; at most 1 MiB after decoding.

contentEncoding.description: Set to "base64" when content is base64-encoded.

deploymentName.description: Deployment name (defaults to the file name).

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector: the first 8 characters of its UUID or the full UUID, lowercase. Omit to use the default engine connection.

FlowEventInstance/create.input.json.title: flow_event_instance_create input
FlowEventInstance/create.input.json.description: Input for sending an event instance to an inbound channel of the event registry. Both an event definition reference and a channel definition reference are required — the engine rejects a body missing either.

eventDefinitionKey.title: Event definition key
eventDefinitionKey.description: Key of the event definition to send (latest deployed version is used).

eventDefinitionId.title: Event definition id
eventDefinitionId.description: Specific event definition id, taking precedence over the key.

channelDefinitionKey.title: Channel definition key
channelDefinitionKey.description: Key of the inbound channel definition that receives the event.

channelDefinitionId.title: Channel definition id
channelDefinitionId.description: Specific inbound channel definition id, taking precedence over the key.

tenantId.title: Tenant id
tenantId.description: Optional tenant the event definition and channel are resolved in.

eventPayload.title: Event payload
eventPayload.description: The event body as a JSON object, matching the event definition's payload contract. Must be an object — the engine rejects an array.

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector: the first 8 characters of its UUID or the full UUID, lowercase.

FlowExecution/trigger.input.json.title: flow_execution_trigger input
FlowExecution/trigger.input.json.description: Input for triggering a waiting execution.

variables.description: Process variables: shorthand map {name: value} or explicit list [{name,value,type}].

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector: the first 8 characters of its UUID or the full UUID, lowercase.

FlowExternalWorkerJob/acquire.input.json.title: flow_external_worker_job_acquire input
FlowExternalWorkerJob/acquire.input.json.description: Input for acquiring (locking) external worker jobs of a single topic. The engine locks up to numberOfTasks jobs for the given workerId; only that worker may then complete, fail or raise a BPMN error on them.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: The external-worker topic to pull work from (flowable:topic on the service task). Jobs are acquired per topic — one call, one topic.

workerId.title: Worker id
workerId.description: Identity of the worker taking the lock. Must be repeated on the follow-up complete/fail/bpmnError/unacquire call.

lockDuration.title: Lock duration
lockDuration.description: How long the lock is held, as an ISO-8601 duration (e.g. PT10M). Once it expires the engine hands the job to the next worker, so it must comfortably exceed the expected processing time.

numberOfTasks.title: Number of tasks
numberOfTasks.description: Maximum number of jobs to lock in this call (batch size).

numberOfRetries.title: Number of retries
numberOfRetries.description: Retries the acquired jobs are given. Once they are used up the engine dead-letters the job instead of re-scheduling it.

scopeType.title: Scope type
scopeType.description: Restrict acquisition to jobs of one engine (BPMN processes or CMMN cases). Omit to acquire regardless of scope.

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector: the first 8 characters of its UUID or the full UUID, lowercase.

FlowExternalWorkerJob/bpmnError.input.js.title: flow_external_worker_job_bpmn_error input
FlowExternalWorkerJob/bpmnError.input.js.description: Input for raising a BPMN error from an acquired external worker job. Unlike fail (a technical failure the engine retries) this is a MODELLED outcome: the process continues along the error boundary event that catches the given errorCode.

workerId.title: Worker id
workerId.description: Identity of the worker holding the lock — the engine rejects a report from anyone else.

errorCode.title: Error code
errorCode.description: The BPMN error code to raise; must match an errorEventDefinition in the process, otherwise the error escapes uncaught.

variables.description: Variables to set before the error is raised: shorthand map {name: value} or explicit list [{name,value,type}].

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector: the first 8 characters of its UUID or the full UUID, lowercase.

FlowExternalWorkerJob/complete.input.jso.title: flow_external_worker_job_complete input
FlowExternalWorkerJob/complete.input.jso.description: Input for reporting an acquired external worker job as done. The variables become process variables, so the following BPMN steps can read the worker's result.

workerId.title: Worker id
workerId.description: Identity of the worker holding the lock — the engine rejects a report from anyone else.

variables.description: Result variables: shorthand map {name: value} or explicit list [{name,value,type}].

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector: the first 8 characters of its UUID or the full UUID, lowercase.

FlowExternalWorkerJob/fail.input.json.title: flow_external_worker_job_fail input
FlowExternalWorkerJob/fail.input.json.description: Input for reporting an acquired external worker job as failed. The ENGINE owns what happens next: it decrements the retries and re-schedules the job, or dead-letters it once they are used up. Use unacquire instead when the worker simply cannot do the work — failing spends a retry.

workerId.title: Worker id
workerId.description: Identity of the worker holding the lock — the engine rejects a report from anyone else.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Override the remaining attempts. Omit to let the engine decrement the current value; 0 dead-letters the job immediately.

retryTimeout.title: Retry timeout
retryTimeout.description: How long to wait before the job becomes acquirable again, as an ISO-8601 duration (e.g. PT5M).

errorMessage.title: Error message
errorMessage.description: Short reason, shown as the job's exceptionMessage in the job store.

errorDetails.title: Error details
errorDetails.description: Long-form detail (e.g. a stacktrace), retrievable via GET /jobs/{id}/stacktrace.

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector: the first 8 characters of its UUID or the full UUID, lowercase.

FlowExternalWorkerJob/unacquire.input.js.title: flow_external_worker_job_unacquire input
FlowExternalWorkerJob/unacquire.input.js.description: Input for releasing the lock on an acquired external worker job. The job becomes acquirable again WITHOUT consuming one of its retries — the right report when the worker cannot do the work at all (no handler for the topic, or a shutdown while the job was held).

workerId.title: Worker id
workerId.description: Identity of the worker holding the lock — the engine rejects a report from anyone else.

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector: the first 8 characters of its UUID or the full UUID, lowercase.
